# Plan: Slot add/remove UI

Users can add custom slots to a machine and remove existing slots from the
machine detail page. Two new API endpoints; slot removal unassigns (never
deletes) any part in the slot.

## Context (current state)

- `machine_slots(id, machine_id, category, created_at)` exists; `parts.slot_id`
  has a partial UNIQUE index. FK `ON DELETE SET NULL` is declared but SQLite
  FK enforcement is NOT enabled in the DSN — so unassign explicitly in the
  delete handler, don't rely on the FK.
- Existing slot queries in `internal/db/queries.sql`: CreateSlot,
  ListSlotsByMachine, GetSlot. Existing handlers in
  `internal/handlers/{machines,parts,handlers}.go`; `SlotResponse` +
  `newSlotResponse` already exist in handlers.go.
- Frontend: `MachineDetailView.vue` shows the slots grid with inline add-part
  forms; `api/parts.ts`, `api/machines.ts` follow a simple fetch style.
- Follow existing conventions exactly: handlers per resource file, sqlc for
  queries, no hand-edits of generated files.

## 1. Queries — append to `internal/db/queries.sql`

```sql
-- name: DeleteSlot :exec
DELETE FROM machine_slots WHERE id = ?;

-- name: UnassignPartsBySlot :exec
UPDATE parts SET slot_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE slot_id = ?;
```
Run `sqlc generate`.

## 2. Handlers — new file `internal/handlers/slots.go`

- `CreateSlot` (POST /api/machines/{id}/slots):
  - Parse machine id from URL (`parseID(r, "id")`).
  - Decode `{category string}`; trim; 400 if empty.
  - `GetMachine` → 404 if missing.
  - `CreateSlot` query; 201 with `SlotResponse{ID, Category, Part: nil}`.
- `DeleteSlot` (DELETE /api/slots/{id}):
  - Parse id; `UnassignPartsBySlot` then `DeleteSlot`; 204.
  - No 404 check — DELETE is idempotent.
- Remove the now-stale `// ponytail: ... slot management is a follow-up`
  comment on `defaultSlots` in machines.go.

## 3. Routes — `cmd/server/main.go`

- Inside `r.Route("/machines/{id}")`: `r.Post("/slots", h.CreateSlot)`
- New top-level under `/api`: `r.Route("/slots", ...)` with
  `r.Delete("/{id}", h.DeleteSlot)`

## 4. Frontend

New `frontend/src/api/slots.ts` (same fetch style as parts.ts):
```ts
createSlot(machineId: number, category: string): Promise<Slot>  // POST /api/machines/{id}/slots
deleteSlot(slotId: number): Promise<void>                        // DELETE /api/slots/{id}
```

`frontend/src/views/MachineDetailView.vue`:
- Each slot card header gets a small `×` remove button (always visible, no
  confirm dialog). On click: `deleteSlot(slot.id)` then refetch. Mention in
  the card title attribute that a filled slot's part moves to "Other parts".
- Append an "Add slot" card at the end of the slots grid: text input for
  category + Add button (disabled while saving or input empty). On submit:
  `createSlot(detail.machine.id, category)`, clear input, refetch.
- Reuse existing `.card`, `.btn-small` styles; keep the grid layout.

## 5. Tests — extend `internal/handlers/machines_test.go`

Add routes to `newTestRouter`: `r.Post("/machines/{id}/slots", h.CreateSlot)`,
`r.Delete("/slots/{id}", h.DeleteSlot)`. Two tests:

1. `TestCreateSlot`: create machine (9 slots) → POST `{"category":"NIC"}` to
   /machines/1/slots → 201 → GET machine: 10 slots, last is "NIC", empty.
   Also POST `{"category":""}` → 400.
2. `TestDeleteSlotUnassignsPart`: create machine → fill slot 1 (part
   "Part A") → DELETE /slots/1 → 204 → GET machine: 8 slots, and the parts
   list still contains "Part A" (unassigned, no slot references it).

## 6. Verify

```
sqlc generate && mise run fmt && mise run lint && mise run test && mise run build
```

## Out of scope

- Renaming slots, reordering slots, per-machine default templates.
- Confirm dialog on slot removal (part is preserved; deleting is reversible
  enough by re-adding).
